text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Three metered wind farms W1 to W3; kept half-hours, true days 1 to 10 (lead 24 to 240 hours). Scored year. Line: mean forecast quantile in 10 equal-count bins of the plant's mean power. Dot: observed quantile of the same level in the bin; a dot above its line means the forecast quantile is too low.'
text.tspan: Three metered wind farms W1 to W3; kept half-hours, true days 1 to 10 (lead 24 to 240 hours). Scored
year. Line: mean forecast quantile in 10 equal-count bins of the plant's mean power. Dot: observed
quantile of the same level in the bin; a dot above its line means the forecast quantile is too low.
